name: GERD (Acid Reflux)

whatIsIt.en: Stomach acid flows back into food pipe, causing heartburn.
whatIsIt.hi: पेट का एसिड भोजन नली में वापस आता है, जिससे सीने में जलन होती है।

treatmentOverview: PPIs (Pantoprazole, Omeprazole) + lifestyle changes.
whenUrgent: Difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, or weight loss — seek medical attention.

name: Constipation

whatIsIt.en: Difficulty passing stool or infrequent bowel movements.
whatIsIt.hi: मल त्यागने में कठिनाई या कम मल त्याग।

treatmentOverview: Fiber, water, exercise; laxatives short-term if needed.
whenUrgent: Blood in stool or severe pain — seek medical attention.

name: Peptic Ulcer

whatIsIt.en: Open sore in stomach or upper intestine lining.
whatIsIt.hi: पेट या आंत की परत में खुला घाव।

treatmentOverview: PPIs + antibiotics (if H. pylori) as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Black stools, vomiting blood, or severe pain — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Hepatitis (Liver Inflammation)

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of the liver, often from viruses (A, B, C) or alcohol.
whatIsIt.hi: लिवर की सूजन, अक्सर वायरस (A, B, C) या शराब से।

diagnosis: Liver function tests + hepatitis virus tests.
treatmentOverview: Depends on type; supportive care + specific antivirals as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Confusion, bleeding, or severe vomiting — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Pneumonia

whatIsIt.en: Lung infection causing air sacs to fill with fluid.
whatIsIt.hi: फेफड़ों का इन्फेक्शन जिसमें हवा की थैलियाँ तरल से भर जाती हैं।

treatmentOverview: Antibiotics (if bacterial) + rest + fluids.
whenUrgent: Severe breathlessness, blue lips, or confusion — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Bronchitis

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of bronchial tubes causing cough.
whatIsIt.hi: श्वास नलियों की सूजन जिससे खांसी होती है।

treatmentOverview: Rest, fluids; antibiotics only if bacterial.
whenUrgent: Breathlessness or blood in sputum — seek medical attention.

name: COPD (Chronic Lung Disease)

whatIsIt.en: Long-term lung disease causing breathing difficulty, often from smoking.
whatIsIt.hi: लंबे समय की फेफड़ों की बीमारी, अक्सर धूम्रपान से, जिससे सांस में दिक्कत होती है।

treatmentOverview: Bronchodilators, inhaled steroids, smoking cessation.
whenUrgent: Severe breathlessness or blue lips — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Sinusitis

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of sinus cavities causing facial pain and congestion.
whatIsIt.hi: साइनस गुहाओं की सूजन जिससे चेहरे में दर्द और नाक बंद होती है।

treatmentOverview: Decongestants, saline, antibiotics if bacterial.
whenUrgent: Vision changes or swelling around eyes — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Tonsillitis

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of tonsils causing sore throat.
whatIsIt.hi: टॉन्सिल की सूजन जिससे गले में खराश होती है।

treatmentOverview: Pain relief + antibiotics if bacterial.
whenUrgent: Breathing difficulty or unable to swallow — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Common Cold

whatIsIt.en: Viral infection of nose and throat.
whatIsIt.hi: नाक और गले का वायरल इन्फेक्शन।

treatmentOverview: Rest, fluids, symptomatic relief (paracetamol). No antibiotics (viral).
whenUrgent: High fever or severe symptoms — seek medical attention.

name: Influenza (Flu)

whatIsIt.en: Viral respiratory illness, more severe than common cold.
whatIsIt.hi: वायरल श्वसन बीमारी, जुकाम से ज़्यादा गंभीर।

treatmentOverview: Rest, fluids, paracetamol; antiviral if prescribed early.
whenUrgent: Breathlessness or chest pain — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Chickenpox

whatIsIt.en: Viral infection causing itchy rash and fever.
whatIsIt.hi: वायरल इन्फेक्शन जिससे खुजली वाले चकत्ते और बुखार होते हैं।

treatmentOverview: Symptomatic relief, antihistamines for itching; antivirals in some cases.
whenUrgent: Breathing difficulty or confusion — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Scabies

whatIsIt.en: Contagious skin infestation by tiny mites causing intense itching.
whatIsIt.hi: छोटे कीटाणुओं से होने वाला संक्रामक त्वचा रोग जिससे तेज़ खुजली होती है।

treatmentOverview: Scabicide creams (permethrin) + treat all family members.
whenUrgent: Spreading infection or severe crusting — seek medical attention.

name: Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis)

whatIsIt.en: Chronic skin condition causing dry, itchy, inflamed skin.
whatIsIt.hi: पुरानी त्वचा स्थिति जिससे सूखी, खुजली वाली, सूजी त्वचा होती है।

treatmentOverview: Moisturizers + topical steroids as prescribed; avoid triggers.
whenUrgent: Signs of skin infection — seek medical attention.

name: Piles (Hemorrhoids)

whatIsIt.en: Swollen veins in the lower rectum/anus causing pain and bleeding.
whatIsIt.hi: गुदा के निचले हिस्से की सूजी नसें जिससे दर्द और खून आता है।

treatmentOverview: Fiber, sitz bath, creams; surgery in severe cases.
whenUrgent: Heavy bleeding or severe pain — seek medical attention.

name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)

whatIsIt.en: Digestive disorder causing abdominal pain, bloating, and bowel changes.
whatIsIt.hi: पाचन विकार जिससे पेट दर्द, फूलना और मल त्याग में बदलाव होता है।

diagnosis: Clinical (Rome criteria); rule out other causes.
treatmentOverview: Diet modification + antispasmodics + stress management.
whenUrgent: Blood in stool or weight loss — seek medical attention.

name: Appendicitis

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of the appendix causing severe abdominal pain.
whatIsIt.hi: अपेंडिक्स की सूजन जिससे गंभीर पेट दर्द होता है।

treatmentOverview: Surgery (appendectomy) — usually emergency.
prevention: No specific prevention; high-fiber diet may help
whenUrgent: Severe worsening pain or high fever — seek URGENT medical attention immediately.

name: Depression

whatIsIt.en: Mood disorder causing persistent sadness and loss of interest.
whatIsIt.hi: मूड विकार जिससे लगातार उदासी और रुचि में कमी होती है।

diagnosis: Clinical assessment by mental health professional.
treatmentOverview: Therapy + medicines (antidepressants) as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Suicidal thoughts — seek URGENT help immediately.

name: Anxiety Disorder

whatIsIt.en: Excessive worry and fear affecting daily life.
whatIsIt.hi: अत्यधिक चिंता और डर जो दिनचर्या को प्रभावित करता है।

treatmentOverview: Therapy (CBT) + medicines as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Severe panic or suicidal thoughts — seek urgent help.

name: Viral Conjunctivitis

whatIsIt.en: Viral infection of eye membrane causing redness and watering.
whatIsIt.hi: आँख की झिल्ली का वायरल इन्फेक्शन जिससे लालिमा और पानी आता है।

treatmentOverview: Usually self-limiting; lubricants + hygiene.
whenUrgent: Vision loss or severe pain — seek urgent medical attention.
